description: This source file implements thermistor-related functions for temperature measurement and sensor configuration within a vehicle engine control system. It includes functions for resistance and temperature calculations, thermistor curve preparation, sensor validation, and interaction with engine parameters.

classes.name: ThermistorMath
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for thermistor temperature calculations, curve preparation, and configuration management.

methods.name: float getR1InVoltageDividor(float Vout,float Vin,float r2)
methods.description: Calculates R1 resistance in a voltage divider based on output voltage, supply voltage, and R2 resistance.

methods.description: Calculates R2 resistance in a voltage divider based on output voltage, supply voltage, and R1 resistance.

methods.name: float getVoutInVoltageDividor(float Vin,float r1,float r2)
methods.description: Calculates output voltage in a voltage divider based on input voltage and resistor resistances.

methods.name: float getKelvinTemperatureByResistance(float resistance) const
methods.description: Computes Kelvin temperature from resistance using the Steinhart–Hart equation.

methods.description: Converts Celsius temperature to Fahrenheit.

methods.name: float convertFtoCelsius(float tempF)
methods.description: Converts Fahrenheit temperature to Celsius.

methods.name: float convertKelvinToFahrenheit(float kelvin)
methods.description: Converts Kelvin temperature to Fahrenheit.

methods.name: float getResistance(ThermistorConf * config,float voltage)

methods.name: float getTemperatureC(ThermistorConf * config,ThermistorMath * tm,bool useLinear)
methods.description: Calculates temperature in Celsius from thermistor configuration and ADC reading, with optional linear interpolation.

methods.name: bool isValidIntakeAirTemperature(float temperature)
